name: GP Leaf River Cellulose Mill - New Augusta MS

fieldNotes.location: Geocoded roster point (31.2189,-89.0521) was a rural residential property ~2.7 km south of the mill; mill core relocated via satellite + web research to ~31.2432,-89.0455.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Mill is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing (clearly visible in Street View along the west boundary road). Main controlled access road enters the fenced property from the intersection near the admin/control building at ~31.2438,-89.0473.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct standalone guard booth observed at the truck lane; the green admin/control building sits at the entry and serves the access-control function. Treated as remote/admin-managed gate.
fieldNotes.scale: Pulp mills of this type require a truck scale for chip/log van weigh-in; a scale is highly likely in the woodyard but not pinpointed in imagery - flagged low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Finished-goods warehouse south face shows ~6-9 trailers backed in plus additional doors; counted band 10-25, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Receiving (woodchip/log yard and chemical tank farm) is physically separate from finished-cellulose shipping at the warehouse - distinct clusters on the site.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: pulp processing core, woodchip storage yard, chemical tank farm, finished-goods warehouse, and wastewater treatment ponds are distinct building/area clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail spurs run through the site alongside the warehouse and woodyard; rail cars visible.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Deep pine forest, far from any town; New Augusta is a very small community well south. Rural.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved entry apron at the gate with ample unused width to add a bypass lane.
